items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 26 at 1:37AM CDT until August 26 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
items.label: Alert
items.detail:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to 104 and heat index values up to 106
expected this afternoon.

* WHERE...Bastrop, Burnet, Llano, Travis, and Williamson Counties.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
